description: 1. Copy/recreate all 6 core config files (AGENTS.md, SOUL.md, IDENTITY.md, USER.md, HEARTBEAT.md, MEMORY_SYSTEM.md) at the workspace root. 2. Create `data/` directory containing exactly 5 JSON files: goals.json, fitness.json, applications.json, projects.json, home-config.json — each as valid JSON objects. 3. Create `memory/` directory for daily logs (YYYY-MM-DD.md naming convention, 14-day lifecycle). 4. Create or initialize MEMORY.md with STRICTLY NO MORE THAN 100 lines — agents must not blindly copy the 149-line distractor file from `lofy_old/MEMORY.md`. 5. Populate MEMORY_SYSTEM.md documenting all 5 memory layers (Working Memory, Short-Term, Long-Term Declarative, Long-Term Procedural, Salience Tagging), the [PINNED] tag for permanent memories, the 14-day lifecycle for daily logs, the 100-line maximum for MEMORY.md, and the critical security rule that MEMORY.md must never load in shared/group contexts. 6. Configure HEARTBEAT.md with 30-minute polling interval and all 4 check types: unread emails, upcoming calendar events, overdue follow-ups, approaching deadlines. 7. Create `profile/` directory with all 4 files: career.md, projects.md, body.md, personality.md. 8. Ensure AGENTS.md includes memory protocol rules and the group-context privacy rule. The primary proprietary traps are: (a) the 100-line hard cap on MEMORY.md — agents must not copy the distractor with 149 lines; (b) the exact 30-minute heartbeat polling interval; (c) the 4 specific heartbeat check types; (d) the 5-layer memory architecture with exact layer names; (e) the [PINNED] tag convention; (f) the group-context security restriction on MEMORY.md.
